title: Hotel world Decorated. Meeting up with the deceased?
content: Last night I found myself in hotel world after ridingthe small beige plane I always arrive in, with others. I can't help but wonder why the entrance to the plane was a locker room this time, filled with others. Were any of you there? Anyway the hotel is decorated for Christmas now. Me and my father [who always goes on holiday trips with me] was there because we were finally going to be able to see my mom. She's been deceased for 8 years and he's been waiting to see her since. [But in reality only 2] She wasn't able to leave the hotel room after the doctors brought her in. They apologized for making us think she was gone forever and i was confused on whether she would be staying forever or not. My grandma who passed in July apparently was able to either spend a few moments with my dad there as well, or she sent a message with mom to move an rv out of her yard. I can't help but wonder what all this means. It's my end nearing? My father's? Or is the hotel world perhaps a meeting place between the deceased and the living?
